answer: Require every agent to lock a stake bond before it can transact, like a walnut that only cracks open after real work: a Sybil farmer must fund each fake identity, and slashing burns the bond when fraud is proven. Reputation then accrues slowly, like basalt cooling into solid rock, while a rare opal-grade attestation from a verified peer unlocks higher limits, so a thousand cheap fakes cost a thousand bonds and buy no trust.
